feed_title: Memory Foam Dog Bed in Brown Velvet with Pillow Bolster, Egg Crate Foam Base, Non Slip Bottom, One Size | PawLunova Watendlath
descriptionHtml:
Velvet on top. Two layers of foam under it. One open edge.

Watendlath is a memory foam orthopaedic dog bed in brown velvet, one size, with a memory foam top over an egg-crate foam base and a pillow bolster on one edge.

Watch a dog settle onto a single slab of soft foam. They go down, the hips keep going, and by the time they stop they lie in a hollow with the floor closer than when they started. Twenty minutes later they try somewhere else.

Two layers split that job. Memory foam on top takes the shape of them. Egg-crate foam underneath carries the weight.

What they get

  • Two foam layers: Memory foam on top for contour, egg-crate foam beneath for support.
  • A pillow along one edge: Somewhere to rest a chin, with three sides open to stretch into.
  • Velvet where they lie: A warm brown velvet surface instead of coated nylon.
  • It stays put: A non-slip bottom, for wooden floors and tiles.

Best for: Dogs who want one edge and open floor for the rest. Borrowdale closes all four sides. This is our only bed with two named foam layers.

Why it is worth the money

£165 is a lot for a dog bed, so here is where it goes. Two layers of foam rather than one. Velvet you would pick for a room you sit in. A bottom that does not skate on floorboards. The foam carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and across 1825 nights, the five years it runs, that is about 9p a night.

And you are not gambling the £165. Tell us inside 100 nights and the collection and the refund are both ours to handle.

Here is what we cannot tell you. We publish no measurements for this bed and will not estimate them. A guessed figure is how a bed turns up four inches short.

Size and fit

One size. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits before you order.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know it will fit?

You ask us. Send their breed and weight.

Delivery cost and timing?

Free above £40. The estimate shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Options are shown before you confirm payment.

What is the egg-crate layer doing?

Carrying the weight. The memory foam above it does the contouring.

Does it suit a dog who is stiff first thing?

Memory foam over egg-crate, one pillow edge, nothing promised. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Go by the sewn-in care label. We will not invent a temperature.

What if they will not settle on it?

The 100 nights cover that, and collection costs nothing.

Message us their size and put two layers of foam under them.
